content: A corresponding-author paper was accepted by **IEEE TGRS**.

content: [**HyperSIGMA**](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/10949864) was selected as an **ESI Hot Paper (Top 0.1%)**.
HyperSIGMA was awarded the **First Prize of the 2025 China Remote Sensing Outstanding Achievements (Theory Category)**.
content_zh: HyperSIGMA 高光谱遥感影像智能理解基础模型入选 **2025 年中国遥感优秀成果一等奖（理论类）**。

content: [**DSFormer**](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S089360802500190X) and [**HyperSIGMA**](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/10949864) were selected as **ESI Highly Cited Papers (Top 1%)**.
content_zh: [**DSFormer**](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S089360802500190X) 和 [**HyperSIGMA**](https://ieeexplore.ieee.org/abstract/document/10949864) 入选 **ESI 高被引论文（Top 1%）**。
我们的 **PHDMamba** 被 **IEEE GRSL** 录用。
我们的 [**MambaMoE**](https://arxiv.org/abs/2504.20509) 被 **Information Fusion** 录用。

content: Won the bronze award (3/121) in the AIRS-2025 Mars Mineral Hyperspectral Classification Challenge [[link]](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/ekA6Y32adnIeEeylF-3KcQ).
content_zh: 获得 AIRS-2025 开发大赛‘星际矿脉’火星矿物高光谱分类挑战赛铜奖（3/121）[[链接]](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/ekA6Y32adnIeEeylF-3KcQ)。

content: HyperSIGMA won the VALSE 2025 Popular Poster Award (2/398) [[link]](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/jYDntHR05zu0YG9lMonYlQ).
content_zh: HyperSIGMA 获 VALSE 2025 人气海报奖（2/398）[[链接]](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/jYDntHR05zu0YG9lMonYlQ)。

content: HyperSIGMA, the first billion-parameter foundation model for hyperspectral intelligent understanding, was featured by the [NSFC](https://www.nsfc.gov.cn/publish/portal0/tab448/info94856.htm), [LIESMARS at WHU](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/dsUYTbZKfYBGmC4mju0zPg), and [Remote Sensing and Deep Learning](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/7CBtVbv2PULV2Vl_mjK3Hw).
content_zh: HyperSIGMA 首个十亿级高光谱智能理解基础模型获[基金委网站](https://www.nsfc.gov.cn/publish/portal0/tab448/info94856.htm)、[武大测国重](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/dsUYTbZKfYBGmC4mju0zPg)与[遥感与深度学习](https://mp.weixin.qq.com/s/7CBtVbv2PULV2Vl_mjK3Hw)报道。
